name: Pinhead Map Icons
about: Pinhead Map Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 3,092 icons designed by Quincy Morgan. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0.

faqs.q: Are Pinhead Map Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 3,092 Pinhead Map Icons are open source under the CC0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Pinhead Map Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Pinhead Map Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 3,092 icons in the Pinhead Map Icons set, designed by Quincy Morgan. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Pinhead Map Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Pinhead Map Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
